task_description: Develop knowledge editing that propagates temporally scoped factual changes through multi-hop reasoning without overwriting valid historical knowledge.
requirements: Achieve at least 90% accuracy on held-out multi-hop questions requiring temporally scoped edited facts.
Keep historical and unrelated factual accuracy within one percentage point of the unedited model.

task_description: Enable long-document reasoning that resolves conflicting, temporally scoped claims while preserving auditable evidence for multi-hop conclusions.
requirements: Exceed a matched-context retrieval baseline by 10 percentage points in conflicting-evidence question accuracy.
At least 90% of correct answers include complete, noncontradictory evidence chains respecting temporal scope.

task_description: Develop a semantic parser that distinguishes genuine utterance ambiguity from model uncertainty under unseen compositional structures.
requirements: Achieve ambiguity-detection F1 ≥0.85 on unseen compositions, using independently annotated sets of valid interpretations.
Match unambiguous-input execution accuracy of a single-output parser trained on identical data.

task_description: Develop selective language-model unlearning that removes source-specific information while preserving independently supported facts shared with the removed source.
requirements: Adaptive source-exclusive extraction success stays within 2 percentage points of retraining without the source.
Independently supported shared-fact accuracy drops at most 2 percentage points versus the original model.

task_description: Develop a semantic parser that generalizes variable binding and quantifier scope to unseen compositions without sacrificing familiar-construction accuracy.
requirements: Achieve ≥90% logical-form exact match on withheld scope–binding combinations with matched vocabulary and length distributions.
Keep familiar-construction exact-match accuracy within two percentage points of an equally sized supervised baseline.

task_description: Develop cross-lingual semantic role labeling that transfers across divergent word orders while preserving language-specific argument distinctions.
requirements: Achieve ≥5 absolute macro-F1 points over matched multilingual fine-tuning on five zero-shot target languages.
Maintain source-language F1 within one point while distinguishing target-specific roles without target-language training annotations.

task_description: Develop retrieval-augmented reasoning that revises multi-hop conclusions under corrected evidence while preserving conclusions unaffected by the correction.
requirements: Improve corrected-answer accuracy by 10 percentage points over standard RAG given identical updated evidence.
Preserve at least 95% of previously correct answers whose supporting evidence remains valid.

task_description: Develop textual entailment models that generalize to unseen quantifier scope compositions while distinguishing semantic changes from paraphrases.
requirements: Achieve at least 85% balanced accuracy on entailment, contradiction, and neutrality across unseen scope compositions.
Preserve predictions across 95% of meaning-preserving paraphrases while detecting 90% of label-changing scope reversals.

task_description: Enable cross-lingual morphological inflection transfer to low-resource languages with grammatical feature combinations absent from source languages.
requirements: Use at most 200 labeled inflections per target language; evaluate on unseen lemmas.
Exceed matched-budget multilingual fine-tuning exact-match accuracy by five percentage points on source-absent feature combinations.

task_description: Investigate whether language models can revise temporal inferences under corrected narratives while preserving uncertainty about underspecified event order.
requirements: Achieve macro-F1 ≥0.85 classifying temporal claims as entailed, contradicted, or undetermined on unseen event structures.
Preserve ≥95% of previously correct temporal judgments unaffected by narrative corrections while updating affected judgments.

task_description: Reconstruct sparse-view 3D geometry with calibrated uncertainty distinguishing unobserved structure from ambiguities caused by reflective surfaces.
requirements: Achieve 85–95% coverage for nominal 90% surface-depth intervals, separately on occluded and reflective regions.
Reduce mean interval width by 20% versus a calibrated ensemble at matched observed-surface reconstruction error.

task_description: Develop an open-world visual recognizer that distinguishes novel classes from domain shifts while learning new classes without forgetting.
requirements: Achieve ≥80% novel-class recall at ≤5% false rejection of domain-shifted known classes.
After ten class additions, retain ≥95% initial known-class accuracy and achieve ≥70% added-class accuracy.

task_description: Develop an image segmentation model that distinguishes genuine boundary ambiguity from unfamiliar anatomy under acquisition-domain shift.
requirements: Achieve unfamiliar-anatomy detection AUROC ≥0.85 on held-out acquisition domains.
Achieve boundary-uncertainty Spearman correlation ≥0.6 with inter-annotator disagreement while matching a supervised baseline’s Dice.

task_description: Recover metrically consistent video depth despite unknown changing focal lengths and independently moving objects.
requirements: With one initial metric scale anchor, keep median sequence scale drift below 5%.
Reduce moving-object depth AbsRel by 15% versus a fixed-intrinsics baseline on held-out cameras.

task_description: Develop visual anomaly detection that separates novel manufacturing defects from unseen illumination and camera shifts using only defect-free training images.
requirements: Under unseen benign shifts, achieve ≥90% defect recall at ≤5% image-level false-positive rate.
Meet targets separately for structural and texture defects without anomalous calibration data.

task_description: Infer calibrated, multimodal 3D human motion from monocular video despite occlusion and previously unseen camera viewpoints.
requirements: Attain 87–93% empirical coverage for nominal 90% motion regions under occlusion and unseen viewpoints.
Reduce prediction-region volume by 20% versus a calibrated unimodal predictor at matched coverage.

task_description: Recover relightable geometry and materials from three images under unknown illumination while quantifying ambiguity between shape, reflectance, and lighting.
requirements: Reduce held-out relighting LPIPS by 15% versus a matched point-estimate inverse renderer.
Achieve 85–95% coverage for nominal 90% predictive intervals on held-out relighting intensities.

task_description: Develop continual visual recognition that distinguishes novel classes from recurring appearance shifts without task boundaries or stored images.
requirements: Achieve novelty-detection AUROC ≥0.90 when unseen classes and recurring appearance shifts coexist.
Limit mean old-class accuracy decline from post-acquisition performance to ≤5 percentage points.

task_description: Develop blind image restoration that distinguishes recoverable detail from ambiguity under unseen, spatially varying blur and noise.
requirements: Achieve 87–93% pixel coverage with 90% intervals narrower than globally calibrated residual intervals.
Remain within 0.3 dB PSNR of a capacity-matched supervised baseline on unseen degradation families.

task_description: Recover camera motion and independently moving rigid-object geometry from monocular video while distinguishing focal-length changes from scene motion.
requirements: Reduce scale-aligned reconstruction error by 20% versus fixed-intrinsics multibody reconstruction on variable-focal-length sequences.
Characterize observational ambiguities and achieve 90% empirical coverage for predicted geometry confidence regions.

task_description: Predict specific protein molecular functions in unseen families while distinguishing genuine functional novelty from incomplete annotations.
requirements: Achieve ≥10% relative macro-AUPRC improvement over sequence-only transfer on family-disjoint, temporally held-out annotations.
Distinguish novel functions from missing annotations with ≥0.80 AUROC on independently adjudicated proteins.

task_description: Infer calibrated cell ancestry from incomplete lineage barcodes and transcriptional states despite state convergence and biased lineage sampling.
requirements: Improve ancestral-pair AUROC by ≥0.05 over barcode-only inference with 30% barcode dropout.
Achieve ancestry-probability expected calibration error ≤0.05 under convergent states and uneven lineage sampling.

task_description: Infer directed cell–cell signaling from spatial transcriptomics while distinguishing shared microenvironment effects under incomplete molecular observation.
requirements: Specify identifiability assumptions and flag observationally indistinguishable signaling and environmental explanations.
On synthetic confounded tissues, achieve ≥80% precision at 50% recall for identifiable directed signaling edges.

task_description: Infer identifiable direct regulatory edges from incomplete single-cell perturbations despite latent confounding and compensatory feedback.
requirements: Achieve ≥80% direct-edge precision at 30% recall on ground-truth networks containing confounding and feedback.
Specify identifiability assumptions and distinguish unsupported edges from evidence of regulatory absence.

task_description: Develop single-cell integration that aligns shared cell states while preserving condition-specific states under partial batch–condition confounding.
requirements: Reduce false cross-batch matches by 30% versus mutual-nearest-neighbor integration at matched shared-state recall.
Specify identifiability assumptions and flag alignments unsupported by biological overlap across batches.

task_description: Predict yeast growth effects of unseen mutation combinations across genetic backgrounds while distinguishing transferable epistasis from background-specific interactions.
requirements: Reduce combination-level RMSE by 10% versus background-aware additive models on unseen genetic backgrounds.
Exceed 75% accuracy identifying epistasis sign changes across backgrounds for independently measurable nonadditive effects.

task_description: Enable identifiable species-removal predictions from compositional microbial time series despite environmental confounding and sparse absolute-abundance measurements.
requirements: Specify sufficient identifiability assumptions and characterize observationally indistinguishable communities with different removal responses.
Reduce held-out post-removal log-abundance RMSE by 20% versus generalized Lotka–Volterra models using identical observations.

task_description: Infer cell-type-specific effects of splicing-factor perturbations on splice-site selection while disentangling splicing regulation from isoform degradation.
requirements: Reduce nascent-RNA ΔPSI prediction MAE by 20% versus an abundance-only baseline on held-out perturbations.
Characterize when splicing and degradation effects are identifiable, explicitly representing ambiguity when they are not.

task_description: Infer mutation-dependent protein conformational transition rates from sparse equilibrium measurements and short trajectories while quantifying kinetic nonidentifiability.
requirements: Predict at least 80% of independently measured, held-out mutant transition rates within twofold error.
Distinguish data-constrained rates from nonidentifiable rates without treating equilibrium populations as sufficient kinetic evidence.

task_description: Determine when unpaired RNA and chromatin accessibility measurements support transferable perturbation-response prediction despite donor–batch confounding.
requirements: Reduce perturbation-response RMSE by 15% versus RNA-only models on unseen donors and perturbations.
Characterize identifiability assumptions separating biological coupling from batch effects, including cases where separation is impossible.

task_description: Learn classifiers that reject shifting spurious cues without environment labels while preserving stable predictive features specific to minority groups.
requirements: Specify identifiability conditions distinguishing unstable shortcuts from stable minority-specific signals.
Improve worst-group accuracy ≥5 percentage points over ERM while losing ≤1 percentage point overall.

task_description: Develop domain-generalization methods that distinguish transferable predictive features from spurious features without source-domain annotations or target-domain data.
requirements: Achieve ≥5 percentage points higher worst-domain accuracy than ERM under unseen combinations of spurious correlations.
Keep average source-domain accuracy within one percentage point of ERM while preserving genuinely predictive features.

task_description: Develop out-of-distribution detection that separates unseen semantic classes from nuisance shifts using unlabeled deployment mixtures with unknown novelty prevalence.
requirements: Achieve ≥80% unseen-class recall while rejecting ≤5% of known-class inputs under predefined nuisance shifts.
Use labeled source classes and unlabeled deployment data, without unseen-class examples during training or calibration.

task_description: Develop a classifier robust to instance-dependent label noise without discarding difficult examples from underrepresented groups.
requirements: Under 30% label corruption, improve worst-group accuracy by five percentage points over empirical risk minimization.
Establish identifiability conditions without requiring clean labels or known group membership during training.

task_description: Develop image classifiers whose adversarial robustness generalizes to unseen corruption distributions while preserving clean accuracy.
requirements: At ℓ∞ ε=8/255, exceed matched adversarial training’s worst-corruption CIFAR-10-C robust accuracy by ≥5 percentage points.
Keep clean CIFAR-10 accuracy within 1 percentage point of baseline, without corruption-specific training or adaptation.

task_description: Characterize when unlabeled target data enables selective prediction with nontrivial coverage under bounded conditional-label shift.
requirements: Identify shift assumptions permitting positive coverage and establish impossibility boundaries when those assumptions fail.
Guarantee target selective error below 5% with 95% confidence uniformly over the specified shift family.

task_description: Develop long-tail image recognition that preserves rare-class accuracy when predictive background correlations reverse without target-domain labels.
requirements: Improve bottom-quintile class macro-accuracy by 5 percentage points over empirical risk minimization under background reversals.
Keep top-quintile class macro-accuracy within 1 percentage point of that baseline using identical training data.

task_description: Develop training-example valuations that distinguish transferable rare-group signal from spurious correlations under previously unseen distribution shifts.
requirements: At 20% data retention, exceed random selection’s worst-group accuracy by ≥2 percentage points.
Meet this target on three unseen shifts without accessing target-domain samples during valuation.

task_description: Develop semantic parsers that generalize to unseen operator compositions despite training correlations between linguistic templates and program structure.
requirements: Achieve 80% exact-match accuracy on held-out operator compositions under reversed template–structure correlations.
Retain in-distribution exact-match accuracy within two percentage points of an identically sized, conventionally trained parser.

task_description: Determine when black-box language-model evaluations can distinguish paraphrased benchmark contamination from genuine generalization under unknown training distributions.
requirements: Achieve at least 80% detection power at 5% false positives against uncontaminated, capability-matched models.
Specify identifiability assumptions and characterize contamination regimes observationally indistinguishable from genuine generalization.

task_description: Develop streaming speech recognition that handles temporarily ambiguous speech accurately while committing words irreversibly with low latency.
requirements: Achieve word error rate within 5% relative of an equally trained revisable streaming baseline.
Keep 95th-percentile word-end-to-commit latency below 800 milliseconds, with zero revisions after commitment.

task_description: Develop streaming speaker diarization that preserves speaker identities through overlap and long absences without revising committed labels.
requirements: Achieve 15% lower overlap-inclusive diarization error than an equally latency-constrained baseline on held-out conversational audio.
Commit labels within 500 milliseconds while handling unseen speakers without a known speaker count.

task_description: Develop unsupervised speech recognition accent adaptation that separates pronunciation shifts from speaker and channel variation without sacrificing existing accents.
requirements: Reduce unseen-accent word error rate ≥15% relative to frozen recognizer using only unlabeled adaptation speech.
Limit existing-accent WER increases to one percentage point under independently varying speakers and channels.

task_description: Develop causal speech enhancement that distinguishes whispered consonants from transient noise without fabricating speech during ambiguous acoustic events.
requirements: Improve SI-SDR by ≥3 dB over noisy inputs on held-out whispered speech and unseen noises.
Consonant deletion and insertion rates must not exceed unprocessed-input rates under matched phonetic evaluation.

task_description: Develop simultaneous speech translation that preserves late-resolved negation and semantic roles while committing irreversible output under bounded latency.
requirements: Achieve at least 20% fewer negation and role errors than a matched-latency streaming baseline.
Keep average lagging below two seconds without reducing overall COMET versus the same baseline.

task_description: Enable zero-shot voice conversion across unseen tonal languages while transferring speaker identity without altering lexical tone or prosody.
requirements: Keep lexical-tone error within 2 percentage points of unconverted speech, preserving source intonation and rhythm.
Achieve 90% target-speaker verification acceptance at 1% false acceptance using evaluators independent of training.

task_description: Develop expressive speech synthesis that transfers phrase-level emotion across speakers while preserving speaker identity and independently specified emphasis.
requirements: Listeners identify intended emotion in ≥80% of phrases, including emotion–emphasis combinations absent from training.
Emphasis placement accuracy exceeds 90%, with listener-rated speaker similarity no worse than neutral synthesis.

task_description: Develop streaming overlapping-speech recognition that preserves speaker identities through interruptions without enrollment or known speaker counts.
requirements: Reduce speaker-attributed word error rate ≥15% relative to a matched-latency streaming separation–recognition baseline.
Handle unseen speakers with 95th-percentile token emission delay ≤500 milliseconds after reference word endings.

task_description: Detect partially deepfaked speech from unseen generators while distinguishing synthesis artifacts from benign recording and transmission distortions.
requirements: Achieve ≥80% detection sensitivity at ≤1% false-positive rate for utterances containing 0.5–2-second synthetic spans.
Meet these thresholds on held-out generators and codecs, with recording conditions matched across authenticity classes.

task_description: Develop streaming code-switching speech recognition that generalizes to unseen language pairings without sacrificing monolingual accuracy.
requirements: Reduce WER within three words of switches by 15% relative to a matched multilingual baseline.
Evaluate unseen pairings; keep monolingual WER degradation below 0.5 percentage points at matched streaming latency.

task_description: Enable dexterous in-hand reorientation of unfamiliar objects while distinguishing incipient slip from intentional contact transitions under visual occlusion.
requirements: Complete 80% of occluded reorientations on held-out objects within 10° orientation error without dropping.
Distinguish unintended slip from planned contact transitions with ≥90% balanced accuracy across unseen friction conditions.

task_description: Develop image-goal navigation that resolves perceptual aliasing in unseen buildings without privileged localization or unsafe exploratory motion.
requirements: Achieve at least 80% goal-reaching success in held-out buildings with visually repeated corridors.
Reduce collisions per episode by 30% versus a reactive navigation baseline under equal travel budgets.

task_description: Investigate contact-rich insertion policies that distinguish recoverable misalignment from jamming under visual occlusion and unknown friction.
requirements: Achieve ≥90% insertion success on held-out peg geometries and friction conditions with 0.2 mm clearance.
Keep peak contact force below 20 N in ≥99% of trials, including jam recovery.

task_description: Develop a legged locomotion controller that identifies hidden terrain yielding limits while maintaining recoverability during exploratory foot contacts.
requirements: Estimate previously unseen terrain’s load-bearing limits with median relative error below 15%.
Reduce falls by 30% versus an otherwise matched nonexploratory controller at equal traversal speed.

task_description: Develop a shared-control robot that distinguishes human intent changes from reactions to its assistance during collaborative object transport.
requirements: Achieve intent-change F1 ≥0.85 for unseen partners when robot assistance itself induces human corrections.
Reduce unnecessary control overrides by 30% versus a fixed-assistance baseline without increasing peak interaction forces.

task_description: Learn insertion policies from demonstrations that transfer across robot embodiments and unseen object compliance while respecting contact-force limits.
requirements: Achieve 80% success on unseen embodiment–compliance pairs, exceeding same-data behavior cloning by 15 percentage points.
Keep peak contact force below object-specific damage thresholds in at least 95% of trials.

task_description: Enable safe sim-to-real transfer for robotic peg insertion when friction and clearance changes are indistinguishable before contact.
requirements: Achieve ≥90% insertion success across held-out friction–clearance combinations using at most 20 real adaptation trials.
Keep peak contact force below 20 N during adaptation and deployment without privileged state observations.

task_description: Develop robotic active perception that resolves grasp-relevant occlusions while accounting for uncertain object motion induced by sensing actions.
requirements: Reduce failed grasps by 20% relative to a fixed-view baseline under matched action budgets.
Maintain object-damage rates below 1% across previously unseen object dynamics and occlusion patterns.

task_description: Enable mobile manipulators to distinguish object slip from localization drift while maintaining contact during furniture repositioning.
requirements: Reposition unseen furniture within 5 cm in 90% of trials with intermittent visual occlusion.
Identify slip versus localization drift with 90% balanced accuracy without external tracking during execution.

task_description: Develop tactile slip prediction that distinguishes impending grasp slip from elastic deformation across unseen materials and sensor wear.
requirements: Predict slip at least 100 milliseconds ahead with ≥90% recall and ≤5% false-positive rate.
Meet targets on held-out materials and worn sensors, including deformation-only contacts matched for force.

task_description: Develop visual question answering that responds to causally relevant image changes while remaining invariant to distractors under compositional shift.
requirements: Answer both original and answer-changing counterfactual images correctly on at least 80% of fixed-question pairs.
Limit answer changes under irrelevant visual edits to 5% on unseen object–attribute combinations.

task_description: Develop video-language grounding that distinguishes repeated actions through temporal relationships while remaining robust to irrelevant visual changes.
requirements: Ground both queries correctly in 80% of event-order minimal pairs (temporal IoU ≥0.5).
Limit accuracy loss to 5 percentage points under background changes preserving actions and timing.

task_description: Enable speech–gesture reference resolution that distinguishes gesture-dependent meaning from speaker-specific correlations under uncertain cross-modal timing.
requirements: Achieve ≥10 percentage-point accuracy gains over speech-only models on gesture-dependent references from unseen speakers.
Limit accuracy degradation to 5 percentage points under irrelevant-gesture substitutions and ±300-millisecond audiovisual offsets.

task_description: Generate synchronized audio from silent video while distinguishing visually determined sound events from acoustically ambiguous alternatives.
requirements: Reduce visible-event audio onset error by 20% versus an equally sized deterministic video-to-audio baseline.
Cover 90% of reference-supported sound alternatives across samples, with visually contradicted events below 5%.

task_description: Develop a multimodal predictor robust to label-dependent modality missingness shifts without sacrificing accuracy when all modalities are observed.
requirements: Reduce worst-pattern error by 10% relative to the strongest unimodal baseline under unseen label-dependent missingness.
Retain complete-modality accuracy within one percentage point of an equally trained complete-modality baseline.

task_description: Enable multimodal dialogue models to distinguish genuine scene changes from earlier grounding errors while maintaining consistent conversational references.
requirements: Achieve ≥85% change-versus-error classification accuracy on matched dialogue pairs sharing final images but differing histories.
Preserve ≥95% of previously correct entity references when revising erroneous visual grounding.

task_description: Investigate embodied grounding of action verbs that transfers across robot morphologies while distinguishing intended effects from observed motions.
requirements: Achieve ≥70% instruction success on unseen morphologies when motion cues conflict with intended effects.
Distinguish identical motions producing different effects while recognizing different motions achieving the same instructed effect.

task_description: Detect false contextual claims in authentic image–text pairs while distinguishing benign reuse under event and publisher shifts.
requirements: Achieve macro-F1 ≥0.80 on events and publishers absent from training.
Keep false-positive rates ≤5% on benign reuse matched to misinformation for image–text semantic similarity.

task_description: Investigate causal effect identifiability reasoning from diagrams, distinguishing structural edits from equivalent redrawings across unseen graph compositions.
requirements: Achieve 85% paired accuracy on identifiability judgments before and after structural edits, including latent confounding.
Maintain 95% prediction consistency across equivalent redrawings of held-out graph compositions.

task_description: Learn audio–video temporal alignment that separates clock drift from genuine event delays despite missing and repeated events.
requirements: Reduce median clock-offset estimation error by 25% versus global-offset alignment under matched missing-event conditions.
State identifiability assumptions and flag timing ambiguities that cannot be resolved from observed modalities.

task_description: Develop informative treatment-effect confidence sets when confounding proxies are weak and their conditional independence assumptions are approximately violated.
requirements: Guarantee at least 95% asymptotic coverage uniformly over explicitly quantified proxy-strength and assumption-violation classes.
Characterize when confidence sets are strictly narrower than outcome-range-only bounds without requiring point identification.

task_description: Develop causal discovery that distinguishes mechanism shifts from latent confounding across environments with unknown intervention targets.
requirements: Specify assumptions enabling identifiable edge orientations and characterize unavoidable equivalence classes.
At 95% orientation precision, improve recall over pooled-data discovery by 10 percentage points.

task_description: Characterize bounds for dynamic treatment-regime effects under simultaneous unmeasured time-varying confounding and informative dropout.
requirements: Establish sharp identification bounds under explicit, separately interpretable confounding and dropout sensitivity constraints.
Construct confidence regions with at least 95% asymptotic coverage uniformly over the specified sensitivity class.

task_description: Determine identifiability of population treatment-policy effects under network interference when treatment influences which social ties are observed.
requirements: Establish identification boundaries under explicit restrictions on interference and treatment-dependent missing ties.
Within identifiable regimes, achieve ≥93% coverage for 95% intervals, with median width ≤2× complete-network oracle.

task_description: Characterize identifiable interventional mediation effects of gene perturbations through noisy cell-state measurements under treatment-induced mediator–outcome confounding.
requirements: Specify identification assumptions and counterexamples establishing when measurement noise prevents identification.
Achieve 90–95% coverage and median interval width ≤2× a latent-state-observing oracle across identifiable simulations.

task_description: Characterize when heterogeneous treatment effects remain partially identifiable with weak instruments and bounded exclusion violations in observational healthcare.
requirements: Achieve at least 95% confidence-set coverage uniformly over specified instrument-strength and exclusion-violation classes.
Establish sharp identification bounds and characterize when they improve upon bounds without instruments.

task_description: Characterize when staggered policy effects remain partially identifiable under network spillovers and bounded unmeasured adoption confounding.
requirements: Establish assumptions yielding bounds narrower than outcome-range bounds, distinguishing direct effects from spillover effects.
Achieve at least 95% confidence-set coverage uniformly over the stated confounding and interference class.

task_description: Characterize treatment-effect identification and uncertainty in randomized trials with nonignorable missing outcomes and imperfect outcome proxies.
requirements: Establish sharp identification bounds under explicit, interpretable restrictions on outcome-dependent missingness and proxy validity.
Construct confidence sets with at least 95% asymptotic coverage uniformly as proxy informativeness vanishes.

task_description: Develop informative partial identification of heterogeneous treatment effects for adaptively discovered subgroups under unmeasured confounding.
requirements: Achieve 95% asymptotic simultaneous coverage across adaptively selected subgroups under explicit confounding bounds.
Characterize when subgroup effect bounds are strictly narrower than bounds implied solely by outcome ranges.

task_description: Characterize sharp policy-value bounds for clinical decision policies with selectively observed outcomes and bounded unmeasured confounding.
requirements: Specify sensitivity assumptions and characterize when bounds certify improvement over the historical policy.
Achieve at least 95% confidence-set coverage uniformly over the stated sensitivity model.

task_description: Develop reward-transferable memory for partially observable navigation where identical observations require different actions depending on distant cues.
requirements: Match full-history policy success rates within 5 percentage points across held-out goal assignments.
Limit persistent policy state to 32 bits while retaining cues through variable-length distractor sequences.

task_description: Develop offline policy improvement certificates that remain valid under bounded hidden confounding without requiring full action coverage.
requirements: Certificates attain at least 95% coverage of true policy gains under the stated confounding bound.
Certify strictly positive gains over the behavior policy in a nontrivial, explicitly characterized regime.

task_description: Characterize when partially observable reinforcement learning permits reward discovery without irreversible failures or a known safe exploration policy.
requirements: Bound the probability of any irreversible failure during learning by 1% under explicit, nontrivial assumptions.
Establish sublinear regret against the optimal informed policy satisfying the same safety constraint.

task_description: Develop decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning that adapts to unfamiliar teammates without destabilizing coordination under partial observability.
requirements: Achieve 20% higher normalized held-out teammate return than matched nonadaptive policies under identical observation constraints.
Retain 95% of familiar-team return without teammate identities, communication, or test-time parameter sharing.

task_description: Develop hierarchical reinforcement learning that adapts to hidden dynamics shifts using frozen skills despite changing skill outcomes.
requirements: Exceed matched-budget flat reinforcement learning by 15 percentage points in success rate on held-out dynamics.
Adapt from observation histories without dynamics labels or low-level parameter updates.

task_description: Identify causally responsible actions in partially observed reinforcement learning despite delayed rewards and correlated, reward-irrelevant actions.
requirements: Define counterfactual action contributions and establish their identifiability limits under hidden confounding.
Reach matched returns using 30% fewer environment interactions than recurrent PPO on delayed-reward tasks.

task_description: Develop reinforcement learning transfer for robotic manipulation that reuses skills under hidden dynamics shifts while limiting negative transfer.
requirements: Match from-scratch success rates using 50% fewer target interactions when manipulation dynamics partially overlap.
On incompatible targets, stay within 5 percentage points of from-scratch success under equal interaction budgets.

task_description: Learn reward-improving policies in partially observed environments while certifying trajectory-level safety from finite offline data.
requirements: Certify trajectory violation probability below 1% with 95% confidence under bounded observation-model uncertainty.
Exceed a supplied safe baseline’s positive expected return by 10% on specified benchmarks.

task_description: Develop RLHF that preserves conflicting minority preferences under policy-induced distribution shifts without observing annotator group identities.
requirements: Improve worst-group preference win rate by ≥5 percentage points versus pooled RLHF, matching feedback budgets.
Establish identifiability conditions separating persistent preference disagreement from annotation noise under distribution shift.

task_description: Develop a continual reinforcement learning agent that adapts to hidden dynamics changes without forgetting policies for recurring regimes.
requirements: Achieve 20% lower post-switch cumulative regret than matched-budget reset agents across recurring, unannounced dynamics shifts.
Retain at least 90% of prior-regime normalized return under fixed memory and no regime labels.

task_description: Develop a learned large-eddy closure reconciling local energy backscatter with long-horizon stability across unseen Reynolds numbers.
requirements: Reduce kinetic-energy spectrum error by 20% versus dynamic Smagorinsky on held-out Reynolds numbers.
Maintain bounded kinetic energy for 100 eddy-turnover times without suppressing all local backscatter.

task_description: Infer spatial conductivity and unknown boundary flux from sparse temperature observations while preserving uncertainty under nonidentifiability.
requirements: Achieve 90% interval coverage within five percentage points for conductivity and flux across identifiability regimes.
Match known-flux conductivity reconstruction error within 20% when joint recovery is identifiable.

task_description: Develop a stochastic subgrid closure that preserves energy budgets and transfers extreme-precipitation statistics across warming climates.
requirements: Under held-out 4 K warming, reduce absolute 99th-percentile precipitation bias 20% versus a deterministic closure.
Keep global energy-budget residual below 0.5 W/m² without climate-specific retuning.

task_description: Develop coarse-grained alanine-pentapeptide dynamics preserving equilibrium populations and slow kinetics across temperatures despite memory induced by eliminated coordinates.
requirements: Match reference atomistic metastable-state populations within 0.05 absolute error at three held-out temperatures.
Recover the three slowest atomistic relaxation times within 20% at those temperatures without atomistic inputs.

task_description: Develop a neural solution operator for scalar conservation laws that preserves entropy admissibility across unseen shock interactions and discretizations.
requirements: Achieve relative L1 error below 5% against converged finite-volume references on held-out shock interactions.
Guarantee discrete conservation and entropy inequalities across grid refinements without retraining.

task_description: Develop a learned turbulence closure that captures bidirectional energy transfer and remains stable across unseen coarse-graining scales.
requirements: Achieve below 10% energy-spectrum error against filtered direct numerical simulations at two unseen filter widths.
Maintain bounded kinetic energy and correct mean subgrid dissipation while reproducing intermittent backscatter.

task_description: Develop a learned surrogate for compressible Euler dynamics that preserves conservation and entropy admissibility across shocks on unseen meshes.
requirements: Keep normalized mass, momentum, and energy drift below 10⁻⁶ over 1,000 periodic, unforced timesteps.
Match an entropy-stable finite-volume baseline’s shock accuracy without increasing discrete entropy violations on unseen meshes.

task_description: Learn reduced models of partially observed Kuramoto–Sivashinsky dynamics preserving stationary energy distributions and responses to unseen forcing.
requirements: Stationary energy-distribution Wasserstein-1 error stays below 5% of the full-system distribution’s standard deviation.
Predict nonzero mean-energy responses to unseen weak forcing within 10% relative error against full-system simulations.

task_description: Develop a subsurface two-phase flow surrogate that preserves local mass conservation while generalizing across unseen permeability connectivity.
requirements: Maximum cellwise mass-balance error stays below 0.1% of injected mass per timestep.
On unseen channel connectivity, breakthrough-time error remains below 5% versus a converged finite-volume solver.

task_description: Develop a learned plasma fluid closure that recovers collisionless plasma echoes while preserving energy under unseen forcing histories.
requirements: Predict echo amplitudes within 10% of Vlasov–Poisson reference values on held-out forcing histories.
Keep unforced total energy drift below 0.1% over 100 plasma periods.

task_description: Design online shard migration for a replicated key-value store with linearizable operations and crash-safe ownership transfer.
requirements: Preserve linearizability and acknowledged writes across retries, network partitions, and one replica crash.
Without failures, sustain ≥80% of migration-free throughput while migrating a shard under continuous writes.

task_description: Design recoverable distributed snapshots for migrating stream operators with reordered messages and concurrent worker failures.
requirements: Recovery preserves a consistent cut and exactly-once outputs after any single worker crash.
Maintain at least 85% of snapshot-disabled throughput without globally pausing processing.

task_description: Design a distributed scheduler for preemptible gang jobs that reconciles tenant fairness, placement constraints, and recovery from scheduler partitions.
requirements: Prevent conflicting resource assignments during partitions, including stale schedulers and partially completed gang reservations.
After connectivity stabilizes, restore scheduling progress within 30 seconds while preventing starvation under feasible demand.

task_description: Design a distributed scheduler preserving tenant quota ownership and performance isolation during tenant migration, adversarial workloads, and network partitions.
requirements: Quota ownership never duplicates during migration, crashes, or partitions; disconnected schedulers cannot exceed assigned quotas.
On healthy workers, unaffected tenants’ p99 dispatch latency remains within 2× their workload-matched isolated baseline.

task_description: Design distributed garbage collection that safely reclaims cycles despite concurrent object migration, network partitions, and crash recovery.
requirements: Never reclaim objects reachable through durable roots or in-flight references during crashes, partitions, and migration.
Reclaim unreachable cycles within 3 collection rounds after recovery and quiescence, without global pauses.

task_description: Design an adaptive join executor supporting mid-query algorithm switches while preserving outer-join semantics under skew and memory pressure.
requirements: Preserve SQL duplicate and NULL semantics across switches and spills without exceeding configured memory limits.
Match the fastest fixed strategy within 20% per query on a declared benchmark suite.

task_description: Design distributed incremental view maintenance preserving snapshot-consistent outer joins and aggregates across retractions, partition failures, and concurrent transactions.
requirements: Match full recomputation at every committed snapshot across 100,000 transactions, including crash recovery.
Maintain atomic multi-table updates without globally pausing writers or rescanning unaffected base-table partitions.

task_description: Design a distributed recursive-query engine that incrementally maintains cyclic reachability under concurrent insertions and deletions with snapshot-consistent reads.
requirements: Every committed snapshot matches least-fixed-point recomputation, including deletions that break or preserve cycles.
Pass 10,000 randomized concurrent update/read histories with worker crashes, without full-query recomputation after individual updates.

task_description: Design a distributed join executor that adapts to changing key skew while preserving bounded memory and retry-safe output.
requirements: Preserve SQL bag semantics under worker retries while respecting a 512 MiB per-worker memory cap.
Reduce p95 completion time 30% versus static hash partitioning on shifting-skew workloads with equal resources.

task_description: Design a distributed query-result cache preserving transaction snapshot semantics across concurrent writes, range predicates, and replica lag.
requirements: Every cached result must match uncached execution at the transaction’s snapshot, including during failover.
Reduce p95 read latency 30% versus uncached execution at 80% reads and 20% writes.

task_description: Design an incremental compiler that soundly reuses cross-module typechecking results despite edits changing overload and trait resolution.
requirements: Match clean-build diagnostics and executable behavior across edits, including newly applicable candidates and ambiguities.
Reuse at least 95% of typechecking results for declarations whose resolution dependencies remain semantically unchanged.

task_description: Design an incremental cross-module optimizer that preserves optimization benefits while maintaining sound cache reuse under symbol interposition.
requirements: Match clean-build semantics under dependency changes, dynamic symbol interposition, and mixed optimized/unoptimized modules.
For single-module edits, halve full-LTO rebuild time while keeping runtime within 5% of full LTO.

task_description: Build a loop vectorizer preserving scalar semantics across data-dependent exits, potentially aliasing accesses, and faulting loads.
requirements: Preserve observable write ordering and precise faults without accessing memory beyond the scalar exit.
Achieve 1.3× throughput versus optimized scalar code on three representative loops combining exits and aliasing.

task_description: Build an incremental interprocedural alias analysis that preserves soundness across pointer escapes, indirect calls, and changing function summaries.
requirements: Soundly handle heap objects, pointer casts, recursion, and opaque external calls under documented IR semantics.
After single-function edits, match full recomputation’s alias answers while reducing median analysis latency by 50%.

task_description: Design incremental link-time optimization that safely reuses optimized code despite changing cross-module symbol resolution and optimization dependencies.
requirements: Preserve clean-build semantics across weak-symbol replacement, visibility changes, and cross-module function edits.
For single-function edits, median rebuild time ≤50% of clean LTO, with ≤3% executable runtime regression.

task_description: Design an ownership type checker for cancellable asynchronous tasks that safely transfer borrowed resources across task boundaries.
requirements: Guarantee memory safety under cancellation and task migration without whole-program analysis or runtime borrow checks.
Accept 12 safe and reject 12 unsafe programs covering nested borrows, ownership transfer, and cancellation.

task_description: Design a session-typed language supporting endpoint delegation and structured cancellation without stranded peers or broken protocol guarantees.
requirements: Establish protocol safety and cancellation progress under fair scheduling and reliable asynchronous delivery.
Under separate compilation, accept 12 valid delegation-and-cancellation programs and reject 12 protocol-invalid variants.

task_description: Design a typed language supporting multi-shot continuations and deterministic resource cleanup without duplicating ownership or invalidating resumed computations.
requirements: Accept resource-safe repeated resumptions; establish type safety and exactly-once cleanup for owned resources.
Pass 30 conformance cases covering nested capture, repeated resumption, cancellation, and rejected ownership violations.

task_description: Design a typed FFI preserving borrowed-memory safety across reentrant C callbacks, asynchronous cancellation, and callback deregistration.
requirements: Support zero-copy borrowed buffers while preventing use-after-free under explicit foreign-code contracts.
Keep callback dispatch overhead within 20% of equivalent unchecked bindings, excluding foreign execution.

task_description: Design a typed Rust–JavaScript FFI preserving Rust aliasing guarantees across asynchronous callbacks, cancellation, and garbage collection.
requirements: Establish memory safety through explicit boundary semantics covering reentrancy, cancellation, and JavaScript-retained Rust objects.
Achieve ≤20% callback latency overhead versus equivalent handwritten unsafe bindings on a declared benchmark suite.

task_description: Design an SSD-backed key-value store that limits write amplification under long-lived snapshots without sacrificing crash consistency.
requirements: Reduce total host-written bytes by 30% versus leveled LSM compaction under identical update-heavy workloads.
Preserve snapshot isolation and acknowledged writes across crashes; keep p99 reads within 10% of baseline.

task_description: Design a tiered MVCC storage engine preserving snapshot isolation and safe reclamation during concurrent migration, writes, and crashes.
requirements: Acknowledged writes and snapshot-required versions survive crashes at every migration and reclamation transition.
Migration increases p99 read latency by at most 20% versus identical workloads without migration.

task_description: Design a persistent ordered index supporting online key-range repartitioning without blocking snapshot scans or compromising crash recovery.
requirements: Concurrent updates, repartitioning, and crashes preserve committed writes and snapshot-consistent, duplicate-free range scans.
During repartitioning, p99 operation latency stays within 2× the same workload’s non-repartitioning baseline.

task_description: Design a multi-tenant storage engine that isolates write latency while sharing compaction capacity and preserving crash-consistent tenant boundaries.
requirements: Keep tenant p99 write latency within 2× its standalone baseline during competing compactions within quotas.
Prevent cross-tenant data exposure and storage quota evasion across crashes and capacity reassignment.

task_description: Design a persistent-memory transactional index combining serializable concurrency, crash-safe memory reclamation, and recovery independent of total index size.
requirements: Recover after every injected persistence-boundary crash without losing acknowledged commits or resurrecting reclaimed records.
Recovery reads at most 64 MiB per 100 GiB index, independent of completed transaction count.

task_description: Design a multipath transport that preserves reliable ordered delivery, bounded buffering, and bottleneck fairness during asymmetric path failures.
requirements: Maintain delivery progress within 8 MiB receiver buffering whenever at least one path remains usable.
Keep competing single-path flows’ throughput within 10% of their equal-share baseline at shared bottlenecks.

task_description: Design a software-defined routing system supporting concurrent, overlapping route updates with per-packet consistency and recovery from controller crashes.
requirements: Every packet follows one committed routing configuration despite overlapping updates and controller crashes.
Limit peak per-switch rules to 2× max(initial, final); complete updates after controller connectivity recovers.

task_description: Design a multi-tenant service load balancer that maintains fairness without retry-driven overload under delayed feedback and partial failures.
requirements: Under feasible demand, each tenant receives at least 90% of its weighted fair throughput.
During backend failures and five-second telemetry delays, retry amplification stays below 1.2 attempts per request.

task_description: Design a network diagnosis system that separates concurrent causal faults from downstream symptoms under asymmetric routing and incomplete telemetry.
requirements: Achieve ≥90% fault-localization precision at ≥80% incident coverage with 30% telemetry loss.
Report observationally indistinguishable fault sets without asserting unsupported single-cause explanations.

task_description: Design a stateful edge proxy that preserves established TCP sessions across anycast rerouting and single-site failures.
requirements: Preserve byte ordering and acknowledged data without endpoint changes, including failures during connection-state migration.
Keep p99 application-visible failover stalls below 500 milliseconds with 50-millisecond intersite RTT.

task_description: Design a multi-tenant workflow runtime enforcing information-flow isolation across shared caches, asynchronous retries, and explicitly authorized declassification.
requirements: Establish termination-insensitive noninterference under concurrent execution and retries, except for tenant-authorized declassification.
Keep median workflow latency overhead below 15% versus identical executions without information-flow enforcement.

task_description: Design a software-supply-chain admission service preserving transitive artifact trust during concurrent dependency updates, signing-key revocations, and network partitions.
requirements: Admission decisions must use consistent dependency snapshots and reject transitively revoked trust after revocation commits.
Maintain p99 admission latency below 100 milliseconds on million-edge dependency graphs while processing revocations.

task_description: Design a multi-region secret broker reconciling emergency credential revocation, partition availability, and rollback-safe rotation.
requirements: Revoked credentials become unusable within 60 seconds, including during network partitions and broker replica rollback.
Unrevoked workloads maintain 99.9% authentication success during 30-second regional partitions overlapping credential rotation.

task_description: Design a plugin execution service preventing explicit-channel secret exfiltration while supporting authorized streaming releases and concurrent policy revocation.
requirements: Zero unauthorized bytes across 10,000 adversarial executions covering secret transformations and revocation races.
Preserve authorized streaming outputs with under 15% throughput loss versus identical execution without enforcement.

task_description: Design a confidential key-release service preserving revocation consistency during enclave migration despite malicious host rollback and forking.
requirements: Prevent revoked-key release after acknowledged revocation across host-controlled snapshots, forks, crashes, and migrations.
Keep p99 key-release latency within 2× an equivalent attested service without rollback protection.

task_description: Design an incremental change-impact analyzer that safely minimizes regression tests despite dynamic dispatch, reflection, and generated code.
requirements: Never exclude potentially affected tests when reflection, generated code, or missing dependencies prevent definitive analysis.
Match full-suite failure detection while selecting at most 40% of tests across 100 benchmark revisions.

task_description: Build an incremental Java taint analyzer preserving interprocedural soundness when edits change heap aliasing and virtual dispatch.
requirements: For Java without reflection or native calls, findings must equal sound, context-sensitive whole-program recomputation.
Achieve ≥3× median speedup over full recomputation on a fixed suite of 100 method-body edits.

task_description: Build an incremental dependency analyzer that prevents stale artifacts despite generated inputs, conditional dependencies, and concurrent filesystem changes.
requirements: Match clean-build outputs across 1,000 adversarial edit sequences, including dependency creation and deletion.
Rebuild at most 10% more actions than an exact dependency oracle across those sequences.

task_description: Design a race detector for C++ coroutine runtimes that handles task migration and custom synchronization without masking races.
requirements: Match an exhaustive happens-before oracle on bounded executions covering migration, cancellation, and custom synchronization.
Keep geometric-mean runtime overhead below 3× uninstrumented execution across a representative coroutine benchmark suite.

task_description: Build a dependency-upgrade analyzer that distinguishes client-reachable behavioral incompatibilities from harmless upstream changes despite dynamic dispatch and incomplete code.
requirements: Achieve at least 90% recall and 90% precision on 100 labeled upgrade scenarios.
Provide reproducible client-level witnesses for incompatibilities; explicitly identify uncertainty caused by unavailable code or reflection.

task_description: Design asynchronous distributed checkpointing that preserves recoverable training-state consistency across worker failures and changes in model parallelism.
requirements: Recover a committed, globally consistent model, optimizer, and RNG state after any single-worker crash.
Support restores across tensor-parallel layouts while limiting checkpoint-induced throughput loss to 5% versus checkpoint-free training.

task_description: Design a GPU-sharing runtime that bounds inference latency while reclaiming memory from concurrent, stateful training jobs.
requirements: Under admitted mixed workloads, inference p99 latency stays within 1.2× its isolated baseline.
Training maintains forward progress through memory reclamation without restarting or corrupting optimizer state.

task_description: Design an elastic training runtime preserving committed optimizer and data-consumption state across concurrent worker failures and membership changes.
requirements: Worker failures during 4–16 GPU resizing cause no lost or duplicated committed training steps.
Stable-membership throughput remains at least 90% of an otherwise identical fixed-membership sharded-training baseline.

task_description: Design distributed Adam state management supporting elastic resharding and crash recovery without mixing optimizer steps or duplicating updates.
requirements: After any single worker crash during resharding, recover parameters and moments matching uninterrupted deterministic execution.
Limit failure-free step-time overhead to 10% versus static sharding with identical hardware and workloads.

task_description: Design distributed training recovery that preserves optimizer and data progress consistency across failures and worker membership changes.
requirements: Recovered executions match failure-free optimizer-update and sample-consumption histories, including failures during resharding.
Recovery adds at most 5% failure-free step latency versus identical training without recovery support.

task_description: Design live firmware updates for an embedded controller that preserve real-time deadlines and actuator consistency across state-schema changes.
requirements: Maintain 1 ms control deadlines throughout uninterrupted updates, without duplicated or skipped actuator commands.
Reject incompatible state migrations atomically; recover a compatible firmware-state pair after any update-time reset.

task_description: Design a restartable device-driver isolation boundary that contains DMA faults without invalidating hard-real-time guarantees for unaffected devices.
requirements: Contain arbitrary driver memory writes, DMA, and interrupt storms across driver crashes and restarts.
Unaffected devices retain verified 1 ms service deadlines during driver faults and concurrent recovery.

task_description: Design an embedded runtime that contains peripheral-driver faults while preserving hard real-time deadlines and safe shared-device recovery.
requirements: Under driver crashes, hangs, and invalid DMA requests, protected control tasks retain 1 ms deadlines.
Recover shared-device service within 50 ms without stale DMA writes or cross-partition state corruption.

task_description: Design runtime verification for multicore embedded controllers that preserves deadline guarantees and sound verdicts despite asynchronous, lossy telemetry.
requirements: Verdicts are sound under telemetry loss and complete for bounded-response violations when telemetry is lossless.
Monitoring adds ≤5% worst-case execution time per control job while preserving all specified deadlines.

task_description: Design a mixed-criticality accelerator runtime guaranteeing control-task deadlines despite nonpreemptible inference kernels and shared-memory interference.
requirements: Under declared execution and interference bounds, all admitted control jobs meet 2 ms deadlines.
Guarantee starvation-free inference progress under adversarial arrivals without compromising admitted control deadlines.
